profiles.label: Director Core
profiles.description: Narrative, Design Atlas, manifest planning, and review contracts.

profiles.label: Visual Studio
profiles.description: Static presentation output plus original imagery, product UI capture, and deterministic raster processing.

profiles.label: Motion Studio
profiles.description: Visual Studio plus short motion, multi-scene video, and media inspection/transcoding.

profiles.label: Full Studio
profiles.description: All general presentation capabilities plus production-grade raster, SVG, diagram, and media tooling. Spatial 3D remains on demand.

profiles.label: Spatial Studio
profiles.description: Full Studio plus deterministic Three.js scenes inside Remotion.

presentation.label: Editable presentation engine
presentation.fallback: Planning and static poster assets only; no editable PPTX delivery.

install.codex: Open Codex Plugins and install or enable the Presentations capability, then start a new task.
install.claude-code: Install a trusted PPTX or presentation plugin, or configure a project-local PptxGenJS renderer.
install.copilot: Install a trusted presentation Agent Skill or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.gemini: Install a trusted presentation extension or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.cursor: Install a trusted presentation Agent Skill or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.generic: Install a presentation Agent Skill or a compatible PPTX renderer such as PptxGenJS.

image_generation.label: Original image generation
